understanding still has 1 undigested unknowns: resolveParallelGate signature: spec 4.7 illustrates one param (raw?), but a two-param form resolveParallelGate(raw, profileDefault) keeps the helper pure and decoupled from the profile-default table (INIT-001). Decided: use the two-param form and document the deliberate improvement.
